content: Google OAuth 2.0 does not support PKCE in pure JS SPAs; client secret cannot be safely used in browser. Refresh tokens are issued but limited per client-user combo and rotate; public clients are vulnerable to token exfiltration (Google recommends DPoP). Practical implication for a static no-backend app: use the Google Identity Services token model (gapi/GIS) with short-lived access tokens and re-consent rather than long-lived refresh tokens, since there is no server to securely hold a refresh token.
